correctness.rationale: All nonstar faces are the exceptional triangles; the star-simplex cover has pairwise point intersections and no triple intersections, so the integral equivariant nerve resolution identifies H1(U) with ker(iota_epsilon on wedge^2). The relative connecting morphism is the signed simplex differential iota_epsilon on wedge^3. Split exactness yields H2=kernel=wedge^3 of the augmentation lattice, identifies the exact octahedral image with boundaries on four-subsets, and gives only five-term relations. A minimal-support representative in a flag complex has nontrivial vertex-link H1, forcing >=6 vertices in degree two. The included standard-library verifier checks actual signed boundaries and symmetry actions at n=4 through 8; finite ranks are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: A full integral S_n-module and character add group-action structure missing from the previously known homotopy sphere count. The all-orbit minimal octahedral generators and exact five-term relations provide a compact geometric integral presentation for every n>=4; the sharp six-vertex minimum is structural, not an arbitrary numerical slice. These data can serve equivariant comparisons and chain calculations without pretending to a new non-equivariant homotopy classification.
